blurb.zh: 蒙山脚下一个猎户家的孩子，为了一张鹿皮越过了「勿入」的断碑，在谷底捡回一只断了八尾的小银狐。从此，他要问一问：什么是仙？
blurb.en: A hunter's child under Mount Meng crosses the stone that says Do Not Enter, for one deer hide, and carries home a silver fox with eight tails cut away. From then on he has one question: what is an immortal?

title.en: Prologue I · The Fall and the Fox
